bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Detroit opened DT Skyler Gill-Howard's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for LB DJ Wonnum (back), S Chuck Clark (hamstring), and G Tate Ratledge (ankle). CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder), CB Keith Abney II (coach's decision), and LB Tyrus Wheat (coach's decision) did not practice Friday, while CB D.J. Reed (hip) and TE Sam LaPorta (ankle) practiced in full [Erik Schlitt](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/detroit-lions-injuries/182466/lions-bears-week-12-injury-report-sam-laporta-chuck-clark-upgraded-on-tuesday).

Week 12 Bears Outlook: Dan Campbell and DC Kelvin Sheppard open installation for the Chicago Bears (8-2, CHI -1.5, HC Ben Johnson, OC Press Taylor & DC Dennis Allen (Ford Field))—a unit ranked #4 in Rushing Yards / Game (142.4 yds) as Detroit prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Dave Birkett](https://bsky.app/profile/davebirkett.bsky.social/post/3n3a3o7h6722m) [Jeremy Reisman](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/detroit-lions-discussion/182850/detroit-lions-vs-chicago-bears-live-discussion-thanksgiving-chat).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (1st in NFC North • #2 Seed in NFC), Detroit carries a 89.8% postseason projection, 43.1% NFC North division title mark, and 20.8% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873081).
